newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moran 2X well plan for PNG-Oil Search.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moran 2X well plan for PNG-Oil Search.

text.p: Participants in Papua New Guinea permit PDL-2 plan to drill a Moran 2X well near the successful Moran 1X well in the central Papuan Highlands, Oil Search Ltd said on Wednesday.
Moran 2X will be targeted downdip of the location where the current Moran 1X Side Track No. 4 well intersected the oil bearing Toro and Digimu sandstones, Oil Search said.
The objectives of the well include further defining the structural configuration of the Moran field and attempting to define the location of possible oil-water contacts downdip of Moran 1X S/T 4.

Oil Search reported a week ago that Moran 1X S/T 4 flowed oil at a peak rate of 8,064 barrels per day (bpd) and gas at the rate of 19.83 million cubic feet per day during a deliverability test of the Toro Sandstone.
In Wednesday's report, it said Moran 1X S/T 4 was running production tubing and preparing to set completion packers.
The well is being completed as a multi zone potential future producer.

After the operator Chevron Corp finishes running and testing the well completion, it will skid the Parker Rig 140, which drilled Moran 1X and sidetracks, to a new cellar on the Moran 1X location and commence drilling Moran 2X, it said.
The Moran site is located 11 km north of the Agogo processing facilities which form the northern extension of the Kutubu development.

The PDL-2 licence holders participating in the well are: Oil Search 7.763 percent, Chevron and The British Petroleum Co Plc 19.375 percent each, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd 9.688 percent, Mobil Corp unit Ampolex Ltd 16.455 percent, Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd affiliate Japan Papua New Guinea Petroleum Co Ltd (JPP) 4.844 percent, Orogen Minerals Ltd 15.750 percent and Petroleum Resources Kutubu Pty Ltd 6.750 percent.
